faces.transcription: Put the Infiltration cards for Sabik's Safehouse into the reserve. No further information.
faces.flavor: Sabik or one of his loyal operatives noticed your monitoring. Photographs of your team were taped to the exterior windows with your real names written on them. A warning: he knows who you are.
